title: Upward Technologies vs e-Boekhouden
content_html:
Upward Technologies vs e-Boekhouden

Upward Technologies and e-Boekhouden serve different needs. e-Boekhouden is a ready-made accounting package for Dutch entrepreneurs, accountants and associations. Upward Technologies is a Dutch software company that builds custom software, automation and AI agents around how your team works, then hosts and runs what it builds. If your accounting process fits a standard package, e-Boekhouden is the faster path. If your process has steps that no package handles well, or if you need accounting tied to custom workflows elsewhere in your business, Upward Technologies builds that.

What e-Boekhouden is good at

e-Boekhouden, according to its website, is a Dutch online accounting program for entrepreneurs, accountants and associations or foundations. It covers invoicing, VAT returns and connections to banks and the Dutch tax authority (Belastingdienst).

The product automates common accounting tasks. Its Autopilot feature recognises the amount, VAT and supplier on purchase invoices and books most of them automatically. It calculates VAT automatically from invoices and receipts for the VAT return. Users can connect their bank, webshop or cash-register system. Invoices can be paid via iDEAL, credit card and PayPal. The product has a direct connection with the Belastingdienst for submitting VAT returns with one click, and it is recognised by the Dutch tax authority.

e-Boekhouden offers a mobile app that gives access to financial administration anywhere.

e-Boekhouden is designed for sole traders (zzp’ers) and small private limited companies (bv’s) that follow a standard accounting flow.

What Upward Technologies does differently

Upward Technologies is not a bookkeeping package. It builds custom software and integrates it with your existing systems. The company starts every project with a paid three-week scoping phase. That phase maps your exact process, settles technical trade-offs, and produces a supplier-neutral scoping document you could take to another supplier. Only then does building start.

Upward Technologies hosts and runs what it builds. Your team does not manage servers or updates. The company also builds AI agents for repetitive work. An AI agent can read and search your company documents, process data entry, or answer questions from your own files and systems, not trained on your data, but reading from it live.

Upward Technologies integrates custom software with your ERP and CRM so data is entered once and shared across systems. It also builds client portals, e-signature workflows, secure file-transfer tools, and automation that ties your accounting to your operations.

The company is small and based in Breda. It does not offer a ready-made accounting package like e-Boekhouden does.

Which one should you pick

Pick e-Boekhouden if: You are a Dutch sole trader or small bv and your accounting follows the standard flow. You need a package that is quick to set up, handles invoicing, VAT and bank connections, and is recognised by the Dutch tax authority.

Pick Upward Technologies if: Your accounting is tied to custom workflows that a standard package does not handle. For example, you need invoicing linked to project tracking, or your holding company runs multiple entities on different systems and needs consolidated reporting. You want data entered once and shared across accounting, CRM and operations. You need AI to process documents or answer questions from your company data. You are willing to invest in a three-week scoping phase to get software built exactly for how you work, and you want the company that built it to host and support it. Upward Technologies can help you build custom software development tailored to your needs.

Pick both if: You use e-Boekhouden for standard accounting and Upward Technologies builds custom software for the workflows e-Boekhouden does not cover. The two can work together.

FAQ

Is Upward Technologies cheaper than e-Boekhouden?

No. e-Boekhouden is a low-cost package. Upward Technologies builds custom software, which typically costs more upfront but is built for your exact needs. The three-week scoping phase helps determine whether custom software is the right investment for your case.

Can Upward Technologies connect to the Belastingdienst like e-Boekhouden does?

Yes. Upward Technologies can build a connection to the Belastingdienst as part of a custom solution. It is not offered as a ready-made feature the way e-Boekhouden provides it.

Does e-Boekhouden integrate with my ERP or CRM?

e-Boekhouden can connect to banks, webshops and cash-register systems. ERP and CRM integration is not a primary focus of the product. Upward Technologies specialises in ERP and CRM integration so data enters once instead of twice.

Can I use e-Boekhouden for a holding company with multiple bv’s?

e-Boekhouden is designed for single entities. If you run a Dutch holding company with multiple bv’s on different systems, see bookkeeping software for Dutch holding companies compared. Upward Technologies can build custom software for consolidated reporting across your group.

What happens if e-Boekhouden does not cover my accounting process?

You can use e-Boekhouden for standard accounting and add custom software for the parts it does not cover. Upward Technologies builds that custom layer and can integrate it with e-Boekhouden if needed.

How long does it take to set up Upward Technologies?

The first phase is a paid three-week scoping exercise. After that, building time depends on what you need. The scoping phase produces a clear project plan and a go/no-go decision before any code is written.
